name: Deformed Heroine ~Jibakurei no Doukyonin~
original_name: でふぉるめヒロイン ～地縛霊の同居人～
source:
A man finds an extremely cheap place to rent and immediately moved in.
But the house he is staying in is haunted by a mischievous girl...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE221020.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个男人发现了一处租金便宜得惊人的住处，立刻搬了进去。
可他住的这栋房子里，却有个爱恶作剧的女孩在闹鬼……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE221020.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
